---
title: "Generic Font Families"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'font: \("[^"]+"'
          - 'codefont: \("[^"]+"'
        -
          - '(font|codefont): \([^)]*"(serif|sans-serif|monospace)"'
---

```{=typst}
#set text(fallback: false)
```

The brand sets `serif`, `sans-serif` and `monospace` as the base, heading and
code families. With `fallback: false` a missing family would show up as
missing glyphs, so each keyword must resolve to a concrete installed font. The
font picked differs per machine; only the absence of keywords is asserted.

# Heading

Body text with `inline code`.
